instruction: Candid outdoor portrait, close-up, eye-level. In front of a waterfront with a large suspension bridge, the bearded man (R2) in a white t-shirt and the woman with buzzed hair (R1) stand close together, smiling at the camera. The man (R2) has his arm draped over the shoulder of the woman (R1), who has a leaf tattoo on her neck and wears hoop earrings. They pose happily side-by-side. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight under a bright overcast sky, casting gentle shadows.
